title: Content Genome
description: Canonical blueprint for an educational content project. All downstream stages read from this schema; changes invalidate dependent artifacts.

domain.description: Subject area, e.g. astronomy, biology, mathematics

cognitive_profile.description: What the learner can do cognitively at this stage

identity_need.description: What the learner needs to feel about themselves, e.g. 'I am becoming capable'

pacing.description: Rhythm and tempo of content delivery

ambiguity_tolerance.description: How much uncertainty the learner can handle

learning_objective.description: What the learner will be able to do, in measurable terms

misconception.description: The common wrong understanding this content corrects

embodied_activity.description: Physical or hands-on activity that embodies the concept

retrieval_prompt.description: Question that triggers recall of the concept

transfer_task.description: Challenge that applies the concept in a new context

teach_back_moment.description: Opportunity for the learner to explain to another

emotional_promise.description: One-sentence emotional contract with the learner

central_mystery.description: The curiosity gap that drives engagement

ritual.description: Recurring action or frame the learner performs

symbolic_object.description: Physical or conceptual object that embodies the learning

replay_reason.description: Why the learner would want to revisit

world_law.description: The rule the world operates on

failed_attempt.description: What happens when they try without understanding the concept

concept_reveal.description: How the educational concept is discovered

resolution.description: How the concept resolves the conflict

next_question.description: The hook for the next episode
